notes: Official AMX data sheet (c.2014 AMX, archived via Cinos.net; content matches AMX's own MXT-701 product/spec page at amx.com). This is a 7-inch tabletop touch panel (5\" x 7-5/16\" x 4-1/8\", 1.9 lbs) - a desktop unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Power is supplied entirely via Power over Ethernet (802.3af, Class 3) through the single RJ-45 Ethernet port; there is no separate AC/DC power connector on the chassis, so no additional power port was added. USB grade set to usb-2.0 per spec (\"USB host 2.0, Type A ports\"). Ethernet grade set to eth-100m since the spec states \"10/100 port\" (100 Mbps max), not Gigabit. The panel also supports NFC and optional Bluetooth via an external USB dongle (MXA-BT accessory), but these are not physical I/O ports on the chassis itself and were not included as ports.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100 RJ-45; also carries PoE (802.3af Class 3) power to the panel - there is no separate power connector on the device

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Two USB host 2.0 Type-A ports; one has limited physical access requiring a right-angle connector
